# SYNESIS_E075 — Error

## Description

Path `file.syn` points outside the project folder.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The path `file.syn` declared in the project points outside the
  project folder. For safety, the compiler only loads files inside the
  folder of the `.synp` (or its subfolders).
  Move the file into the project folder and fix the path.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **IncludePathEscapesProject**: `filename`
